text:
maya: Vendor submitted final pen-test PDF. Top items: CI role too broad, missing KMS change history, and sampled logs absent for a few transactions. Asking for artifacts for retest. Need minimal approach.
samir: I can provision a timebound 'pt-assessor' role. Window: 2025-08-05T09:00:00Z to 2025-08-05T11:00:00Z. Policy: s3:GetObject on sec-evidence/pt/ plus kms:DescribeKey and kms:GetKeyRotationStatus only. No decrypt. Will add external-id and restrict source IPs.
olga: I will assemble artifacts: cloudtrail_kms_slice.json, kms_get-key-rotation-status.txt, kms_aliases.txt, and a redacted app-log-sample.json. Will upload to s3://sec-evidence/pt/ and post presigned links valid 5 days. Naming: pt_bundle_1776001234.zip.
dante: SRE note: any role touching KMS/S3 needs one SRE reviewer and a simple rollback plan (delete role + policy). I'll review the CR when Samir posts it.
security-bot: Intake ticket SEC-2025-1457 created and linked. Reminder: include sha256 checksums for all artifacts and sign the index file. See runbook https://redwood.internal/security/pt-runbook.
maya: Thanks. Target retest: Wed 2025-08-06 14:00 UTC if artifacts uploaded by Mon EOD. Olga please confirm ETA.
olga: ETA Mon 2025-08-04 18:00 UTC. I'll include an index.csv mapping findings->files and redaction notes.
samir: I'll open the CR today, tag @dante for SRE review, and include exact revoke commands: aws iam detach-role-policy && aws iam delete-role.
maya: Perfect. We'll use this thread as our single source of truth for artifacts and scheduling. If anything blocks, escalate to @security-bot.
